dct_title_s: Landscape Features - Points (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This coverage contains physiographic features represented by points. Features included are mountain passes, sink holes and craters.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, natural resource evaluation and monitoring, physiographic analysis, land use planning, environmental monitoring, management and impact analysis, economic analysis and other types of geographic analysis. Data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
